column6: Shrine of @wSN{Nibru}, shrine surpassing the @fsux{abzu}, shining @wTN{E-kur}; your prince is the Great Mountain @wDN{Enlil} who surpasses the Prince @noteref{i.e. @wDN{Enki}}. Your great lady is the good woman, Mother @wDN{Ninlil}, excelling in refinement. Your caretaker is one whose vigour is surpassing, the hero @wDN{Ninurta}. The chief minister @noteref{i.e. @wDN{Nuska}}, who is worthy of your fair copper vessels, who makes your bedchamber exceedingly pleasant, is also the guardian watching over your honourable divine powers; he is the shepherd watching over your honourable divine powers. Your provider, who was engendered by the Great Mountain and was born by @wDN{Ninlil} -- @wRN{Išme-@wDN{Dagan}}, who was engendered by the Great Mountain, and was born by @wDN{Ninlil}, he who has achieved a high reputation among his numerous people, throws himself at your feet.

@wSN{Nibru}, your praise suits the mouth! May it be uttered by every mouth! The @wDN{Anuna} gods always stand by your truthful utterances. Shrine @wSN{Nibru}, primeval city, where the divine powers are allotted, sweet is your praise! At the great festivals prepared with care in @wSN{Nibru}, all the great gods …… the majesty of @wDN{Enlil} and @wDN{Ninlil}.
